name: BMPT Tank
description: The BMPT is equipped with the drive system of the T-90 tank, a 30mm 2A42 automatic cannon, 850 rounds of artillery shells, Shturm-S anti-tank missiles, a new generation cord machine gun carrying 2,000 rounds of ammunition and two 30mm AG-17D grenade launchers. The BMPT has structurally implemented an integrated fire control series configuration, and is also equipped with modern thermal vision devices, automated firefighting systems, and weapons of mass destruction protection systems. In the end, military personnel gave BMPT the nickname "Death Combine"!
